//: Map of Windows Forms sources to their Avalonia twins. One entry per ported source file.
status: scaffolded (compiles, layout unfinished) | functional (works, reduced feature set) | parity (feature-complete twin).
basedOn: the upstream commit the twin was last synchronized with.
eng/avalonia/upstream-drift.sh joins upstream diffs against this map; keep it accurate when porting or syncing.

src/app/GitUI/CommandsDialogs/FormBrowse.notes: Reduced shell: five browse panes, repository/refresh/fetch actions, configurable shortcuts for five actions, a Scripts menu for enabled user-menu scripts, and commit before/after lifecycle scripts; script editor, pull/push lifecycle hooks, revision context actions, and full toolbars remain absent.

src/app/GitUI/UserControls/RevisionGrid/.notes: Revision history with graph, ref labels, selection, and basic message/author/committer filters. No column providers, context menu, or hotkeys yet.
Shared revision-filter argument builder compiled unchanged into the Avalonia assembly.
Shared revision-filter model compiled unchanged into the Avalonia assembly.
Covered by golden-image tests in GitUI.Avalonia.Tests.

src/app/GitUI/UserControls/FileStatusLis.notes: Read-only list with change-kind markers and History/Blame actions; grouping, filtering, staging, and full context menus are not ported.

src/app/GitUI/CommandsDialogs/FormFileHi.notes: Reduced history/blame window; follows renames and resolves the historical path for selected-revision blame. No revision diff or legacy blame options.

src/app/GitUI/Editor/FileViewer.cs.notes: Read-only diff on AvaloniaEdit; no margins, encodings menu, or blame yet.

src/app/GitUI/CommitInfo/CommitInfo.cs.notes: Simplified header + message; no links, avatars, or branch/tag expansion yet.

src/app/GitUI/LeftPanel/RepoObjectsTree..notes: Flat Branches/Remotes/Tags lists; no nested folders, stashes, or submodule tree. Basic submodule update/sync is available from the Repository menu.

src/app/ResourceManager/GitExtensionsFor.notes: Translation wired; hotkey dispatch comes in Phase 2.

src/app/GitExtUtils/GitUI/DpiUtil.cs.notes: Identity twin: Avalonia layout units are DIP, scale is always 1.

src/app/GitUI/GitModuleForm.cs.notes: UICommands/Module plus shared script contracts; configurable browse hotkeys and Avalonia script services are wired through the Avalonia service registry.

src/app/GitUI/GitExtensionsDialog.cs.notes: MainPanel/ControlsPanel chrome is declared per-dialog in axaml, not inherited.

src/app/GitUI/GitUICommands.cs.notes: Process dialog members are real; all other members throw NotImplementedException.

src/app/GitUI/ServiceContainerRegistry.c.notes: Registers plain text console emulation, the Avalonia browse hotkey loader, and the shared user-script manager/runner with Avalonia prompt adapters.

src/app/GitUI/Hotkey/HotkeySettings.cs.notes: Shared XML settings model compiled unchanged for Avalonia hotkey persistence.

src/app/GitUI/ScriptsEngine/ScriptEvent..notes: Shared script event identifiers compiled unchanged.

src/app/GitUI/ScriptsEngine/IScriptOptio.notes: Shared script option form contract; implemented by Avalonia prompt adapters.

src/app/GitUI/ScriptsEngine/IUserInputPr.notes: Shared prompt contract implemented by the Avalonia simple prompt.

src/app/GitUI/ScriptsEngine/ScriptOption.notes: Shared token/options parser compiled unchanged; Avalonia supplies modal ref and string selectors.
Shared script option provider base compiled unchanged.

src/app/GitUI/ScriptsEngine/ScriptsManag.notes: Shared user-script configuration loading and menu filtering compiled unchanged.
Shared runner supports process, PowerShell, plugin, and ref-navigation commands; URL opening uses xdg-open on non-Windows systems.

src/app/GitUI/ScriptsEngine/ScriptInfo.c.notes: Avalonia-local XML model retains existing property names and icon metadata but does not render System.Drawing icons.

src/app/GitUI/ScriptsEngine/SimplePrompt.notes: Avalonia modal input/confirmation adapter for shared script tokens.

src/app/GitUI/ScriptsEngine/FormFileProm.notes: Avalonia file-selection adapter for script tokens.

src/app/GitUI/ScriptsEngine/PowerShellHe.notes: Selects powershell.exe on Windows and pwsh on non-Windows systems.

src/app/GitUI/UserControls/RevisionGrid/.notes: Shared selector contract is adapted to a centered Avalonia modal used by script ref tokens.
Shared selector contract is adapted to a centered Avalonia modal used by script string tokens.

src/app/GitUI/HelperDialogs/FormStatus.c.notes: Plain text console only; no taskbar progress or status badge icons.

src/app/GitUI/HelperDialogs/FormProcess..notes: Headless end-to-end success and failure tests pass; real-window integration arrives with the first FormBrowse action.

src/app/GitUI/UserControls/PasswordInput.notes: No drag and drop of text; eye button has no image yet.

src/app/GitUI/ConsoleEmulation/PlainText.notes: Read-only TextBox output; no clickable links yet.

src/app/GitExtensions/Program.cs.notes: Entry point twin (with App.axaml.cs); initializes managed extensibility for Avalonia plugin scripts and launches the browse UI.
